_comment: Status-tint ratchet ceiling (audit AB-2) — the count of inline `color-mix(` occurrences under web/src/pages, measured by countInlineColorMix() in statusTint.test.ts. It may only SHRINK: a new hand-rolled tint turns CI red, and each migration to ui/StatusPill lowers this number IN THE SAME COMMIT. Keep it at the measured actual and BRACKET rather than assume — a ceiling of 177 fails with 'expected 178 to be less than or equal to 177', so the live count is exactly 178. Slack is not a safety margin here, it is a hole: one unit of it lands the next new inline tint green and unrecorded (`primitiveAdoption.baseline.json` records that hole absorbing a real regression). 179 -> 178 (bugfix-stale-search-binding): settings/SearchPanel.tsx's provider-state chip needed a THIRD state, `not installed`, and the row hand-rolled the 16% tint + ink pair twice; both toned states now ride the primitive, so the file went 2 -> 0 while gaining a state. `not configured` stayed a local span on purpose — a solid surface fill is a neutral GROUND, not a tone tint, which is the same split settings/bento.tsx draws and design/primitiveShadowing.test.ts pins. The remaining SearchPanel mix is the selected row's 12% primary fill, a selection ground this ratchet's own header names as legitimately non-pill.
